_: The model catalogue. Prices in USD per million tokens, at standard (non-promotional) rates. This is DATA because it changes underneath the app: Anthropic adjusts pricing and ships models, and a stale table here makes /fortschritt report the wrong spend — which, now that each learner brings their own key, is wrong about their money. Principle 4 says never show a number you cannot point at a row for; a hardcoded price list is exactly that number.
_roles: Two roles the app assigns work to. `quality` handles conversation and writing correction, where a missed error is one the learner keeps making. `cheap` handles mechanical explanations on a cache miss. Changing which model fills a role is a change to this file, not to the code.
_cache: Anthropic's cache multipliers, applied to the INPUT rate. A read is a tenth. A write costs extra, and how much depends on the TTL — 1.25x for the 5-minute default, 2x for one hour. The tutor prompt is written with a 1-hour TTL (see ai.ts), so charging it at the 5-minute rate under-reported every conversation; the old constant admitted this in a comment and kept doing it. Both are here now and the caller says which it used.
